title: B2B Agent Outreach Specialist(freelancer must located in china)
description:

title: OpenStudio / EnergyPlus Expert Needed for Research
description:
Subject: OpenStudio / EnergyPlus Expert for Research Project

I am writing to express my strong interest in your research project requiring OpenStudio and EnergyPlus expertise. With my background in building performance simulation and energy modeling, I can assist you in navigating complex simulation workflows and data analysis to meet your research objectives.

My experience includes developing robust HVAC systems, building geometry, and energy models within the OpenStudio/EnergyPlus environment. I am well-versed in running parametric simulations and extracting precise performance metrics to support data-driven research. I am comfortable working with custom scripts and troubleshooting convergence issues to ensure your model remains accurate and efficient.

To ensure I tailor my approach to your specific goals, I have two quick questions:
1. Does your research focus on a specific climate zone, building typology, or a unique HVAC system configuration?
2. Are you looking for assistance with initial model setup and calibration, or are you looking for support with post-processing and analysis of existing simulation data?

Regarding the timeline, I can begin immediately upon selection. I propose a phased delivery: first, a preliminary review of your model or requirements, followed by the simulation runs and, finally, a concise report detailing the methodology and final data outputs. I am confident I can complete the requested scope within the $675 budget.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss the specific parameters of your research. Please let me know when you are available for a brief chat to finalize the project roadmap. I look forward to contributing to your work.
